patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,34 @@
-def transpose(text: str) -> str:
-    pass
+def transpose(text: str) -> str:
+    if not text:
+        return ""
+    
+    lines = text.split('\n')
+    
+    # Handle empty lines
+    if not lines or (len(lines) == 1 and lines[0] == ''):
+        return ""
+    
+    # Find the maximum length
+    max_length = max(len(line) for line in lines)
+    
+    # Pad lines to the left with spaces to make them all the same length
+    padded_lines = []
+    for line in lines:
+        padding_needed = max_length - len(line)
+        padded_line = ' ' * padding_needed + line
+        padded_lines.append(padded_line)
+    
+    # Transpose
+    transposed_lines = []
+    for i in range(max_length):
+        transposed_line = ''.join(padded_lines[j][i] for j in range(len(padded_lines)))
+        transposed_lines.append(transposed_line)
+    
+    # Remove trailing spaces from each line and handle empty result
+    result_lines = []
+    for line in transposed_lines:
+        # Only strip from the right
+        stripped_line = line.rstrip()
+        result_lines.append(stripped_line)
+    
+    return '\n'.join(result_lines)
